answers.explanation: It's not solvable, but some approaches have proven successful.
Hardware and system type (desktop, mobile, real time...) set the starting constraints.
Users want a system that's convenient, easy to learn, reliable, safe, and fast.
System goals are those of the people who design, build, and maintain the OS.
Users and builders both want reliability.
Speed can fight maintainability; safety can fight convenience.
No single answer satisfies every goal, so designs vary widely.
